inputs.original_text:
They want us to believe this is just standard political rhetoric, but anyone with their eyes open can see the hidden strings being pulled right out in the open. President John Mahama comes out with this so-called "notable declaration," claiming that the nation's foundational policies are intricately linked to its legal frameworks, cultural ethos, and collective societal agreement. Whose societal agreement? Manufactured consent, more like. 

Notice how they always wrap the real agenda in layers of institutional buzzwords. He stands there talking about his dedication to upholding the rule of law amidst the increasingly complex landscape of global discussions surrounding human rights, but that's just cover for the globalist puppet masters tightening their grip. It’s all a carefully scripted distraction to manage the narrative from the top down. When he drops the line, “I took an oath to uphold [...]”, it's the exact kind of guarded, pre-approved signaling designed to keep the public blind to the real coordination happening behind the scenes. Don't fall for the official story.
